episodes.title: Betting
episodes.summary: Customs officer Heeju agrees to help her pilot boyfriend Dokyung with a suspicious deal.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: Hiding in the one place she swore she'd never return, Heeju guards the gold from her pursuers.

episodes.title: Partnership
episodes.summary: Woogy makes Hee-ju an offer she can't refuse, as Director Park steps up his search for the gold.

episodes.title: That Person
episodes.summary: Sun-ok takes the fall for Hee-ju's crime. In return, Hee-ju prepares one final surprise for her.

episodes.title: Secret
episodes.summary: Heeju joins forces with Woogy but doesn't trust him. As the others close in, Heeju stands alone.

episodes.title: Fissure
episodes.summary: The owner of the gold bars is back. Director Park goes mad, while Heeju fights to keep the gold safe.

episodes.title: Villains
episodes.summary: Heeju doesn't hide her desire for the gold, and Jinman learns an unexpected truth.

episodes.title: Choice
episodes.summary: Jinman is shocked and confused after discovering Heeju's identity and Woogy finds himself in danger.

episodes.title: Consequences
episodes.summary: Jin-man makes a bold move and Do-kyung goes to see Hee-ju.

episodes.title: Gold Land
episodes.summary: Everyone chasing the gold finally arrives in the same place.
